slots.notes: Fullscreen looping muted autoplay+playsInline hero background video, position:absolute full width/height, object-fit:cover with object-position:bottom, sitting behind the white nav and centered hero stack. A 32px-high bottom gradient overlay fades transparent -> #2B3534 into the next dark section, so footage should be calm/mid-toned to keep the white hero text and word-by-word reveals legible. Native source is a CloudFront-hosted MP4.

Functional UI chrome from lucide-react, NOT brand assets: Zap ('Start Wellness Check' pill), Stethoscope ('Chat with MedAI' pill), BarChart3 ('View Insights' pill) inside the #2B3534 input box's horizontally-scrolling white-border/rounded-full button row, plus Send in the white/gray-800 send button. Rendered white/currentColor (gray-800 inside the send button). Optional socket: only swap if the brand ships an equivalent line-icon set; otherwise the lucide defaults stand.

mechanic: A white-navbar-over-fullscreen-looping-video hero whose object-cover footage (object-position:bottom, 32px transparent->#2B3534 bottom fade) sits behind a centered stack — AnimatedText word-by-word fadeUp headline + subheading (0.6s ease-out, 0.1s/word stagger, fill forwards) above a #2B3534 rounded-2xl input box with a transparent textarea, a horizontally-scrolling hidden-scrollbar row of icon action pills with a right-edge fade, and a Send button — followed by a full-width #2B3534 two-column section repeating the same word-by-word reveal.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS (responsive utility classes, mobile-first md: breakpoints) with lucide-react icons (Send, Zap, Stethoscope, BarChart3); Inria Serif (300/400/700) loaded from Google Fonts in index.html, headings set in Inria Serif with letter-spacing:-0.07em and body in the Helvetica Neue system stack; a hand-authored index.css carries the fadeUp @keyframes / .animate-fadeUp and the .scrollbar-hide rules, and AnimatedText is a custom word-splitting component (no Framer Motion / GSAP).
reskinNotes: The palette is expressed as Tailwind utility classes hardcoded in markup (bg-white, text-gray-900/600/800, gray-300/400, white text on dark) plus the literal brand hex #2B3534 baked inline in the input-box and second-section backgrounds and the 32px bottom-gradient overlay (transparent -> #2B3534), so reskinning means find-replacing those classes/hex rather than editing tokens. Border/hover affordances on the action pills are white-at-opacity (white/15 border, white/10 hover) tuned to a dark scene. 'Vitara' is a plain text wordmark (no logo asset socket) and the action pills are Lucide icons, so rebranding the mark/icons means editing markup, not swapping assets. All copy is hardcoded inline — nav menu (Home, Services, Team, Membership, Resources), Login/Sign up, the h1 'Smart Care Begins with Data + Insight', subheading, the textarea placeholder, the three action labels, and the second-section heading/body — and the AnimatedText word-splitting is structural to the entrance motion. Headings depend on Inria Serif metrics (letter-spacing:-0.07em across a text-4xl->7xl responsive scale), so a wider display face or longer copy can reflow the tight headlines.
